items.title: Salesforce (CRM) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Split On AI Growth
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Salesforce stock has been adjusted from US$248.24 to US$241.72, a relatively small move that still signals a shift in how the story is being modeled. This change sits against mixed Street commentary, with some analysts encouraged by Agentforce, Fin and large government wins, while others focus on slower core growth and open questions around AI monetization.
